members_list_description: Review members by group and invitations that have not been used yet
members_edit_self_hint: You cannot change your own group or role. Ask another Owner.
members_remove_description: They will no longer be able to sign in to the dashboard or the wallet. If they are an owner of the headquarters Safe, a proposal to remove them is created and runs after two approvals.
members_updated_with_proposal: Member updated, and a headquarters Safe owner change was proposed. It runs after two approvals.
members_removed_with_proposal: Member removed, and a proposal to remove them as a headquarters Safe owner was created. It runs after two approvals.
members_owner_change_add_description: Add {member} as an owner of the headquarters Safe
members_owner_change_remove_description: Remove {member} as an owner of the headquarters Safe
members_invitations_description: Invitations and sign-in method links that are unexpired and unused
members_invite_description: Invitation links are valid for 7 days. The member joins with the same invitation either in the dashboard (password) or in the wallet (passkey). Owners and Approvers need both, so they add the other one from the account page after joining.
members_invite_created_description: Send one of the links to the member. Once they register with either link, the invitation is used up.
members_invite_link_dashboard: Link to join in the dashboard
members_invite_link_dashboard_descriptio: They set a password to join.
members_invite_link_wallet: Link to join in the wallet
members_invite_link_wallet_description: They open it on a phone and register a passkey to join.
members_field_role_store_hint: Store groups can only be assigned the Viewer role.
members_field_role_signer_hint: Their passkey signer becomes an owner of the headquarters Safe. Adding an owner requires two approvals.
members_error_store_viewer_only: Store groups can only be assigned the Viewer role
members_error_email_member: This email already belongs to a member. Change their group or role by editing the member.
members_error_email_invited: This email has an open invitation. Revoke it before inviting again.
members_error_self_demote: You cannot change your own group or role. Ask another Owner.
members_error_self_remove: You cannot remove yourself from the organization
members_error_last_owner: This change would leave the organization without an Owner
members_error_min_safe_owners: This change would leave the headquarters Safe with fewer than {min} owners
members_error_has_history: This member has payout or owner change requests or approvals on record and cannot be removed
members_error_revoke_gone: This invitation has already been used or revoked
members_account_description: Review your member details and sign-in methods
members_account_passkey_description: Open the link on your phone to register a passkey in the wallet. Only you can use the link.
members_account_passkey_required: Owners and Approvers need a passkey to approve payouts and owner changes
members_account_passkey_issue: Issue a link to add a passkey
members_account_passkey_link: Link to open in the wallet
members_account_passkey_link_expires: Valid until {expiresAt}. Issuing a new link disables this one.
